description:
FILED s492c (Opus, 2026-09-21) beside the new lib/MIME/Base64.pm.

`lib/MIME/Base64.pm` (plain Perl, s492c) takes the dist's own t/ from 0 to 437
of 495 rows.  The residue is t/quoted-print.t (58 rows): core
MIME/QuotedPrint.pm is a thin Perl wrapper whose two functions are XS in
MIME::Base64's Base64.xs, so `use MIME::QuotedPrint` loads and then dies
"Undefined subroutine &MIME::QuotedPrint::encode_qp called".

It is ~40 lines of plain Perl (RFC 2045 Â§6.7): encode everything outside
33-60 and 62-126 (plus tab and space, except at end of line) as `=XX`, soft
line breaks `=\n` at 76 columns, `$eol` replacing "\n", binary mode encoding
"\n" too and implied by an empty `$eol`; decode reversing that and stripping
trailing whitespace per line.  perl is the oracle and t/quoted-print.t is the
acceptance.
subject: MIME::QuotedPrint (encode_qp / decode_qp) is absent -- the last 58 rows of the MIME-Base64 dist, and what PerlIO::via::QuotedPrint needs
